name: Lian Hong Art. Co., Ltd.
summary: Lian Hong Art. Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise specializing in the development and production of diverse hinge mechanisms. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of hinge types, such as auto-lock, dual-axis synchronization, center, sheathed pipespring, autostand, Webcam kickstand, link, POM, motor clutch, and car seat headrest adjustment hinges. Additionally, it fabricates specialized hinge stands. These high-quality components are engineered for integration into various products, including laptop computers, digital cameras, display stands, and automotive applications. Lian Hong Art. Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
